clock: All 2,422 original capture frames at 120 Hz; no selection, clipping or downsampling.
point_targets: Every mapped role requests its captured world joint origin multiplied by the unchanged transfer leg scale, with zero world offset.
orientation_targets: Keep the current transferred target joint orientations; this experiment isolates impossible positional demands.
editable_rotation_roles: All 19 roles in the unchanged target profile; source-relative 25-degree local rotation caps.
fixed: All local translations and all unmapped helper local transforms. No root translation, length change, floor lift or numerical gate relaxation.
preflight: Conditional triangle-inequality exclusion for invariant endpoint distances. Record every tested invariant pair and all residuals; skip nonlinear optimization only on proven numerical exclusion. Non-exclusion is not feasibility.
purpose: Determine whether uniformly scaled captured positions are admissible pose-fitting targets on the unchanged rig; not a contact fix or release threshold calibration.
